verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter documents a full EB-2 NIW self-petition service: brief, letters, I-140 filing, RFE responses, and no employer required. It separately offers O-1 work visas and says it plans 'next steps early,' so both halves of the path exist. But nothing explicitly frames NIW as the continuation after an O-1, and EB-1A is never mentioned. Missing for 10: any EB-1A offering, explicit documentation of an O-1-to-green-card transition strategy, independent corroboration.
